backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin inclusion and two public Motoko types for render order rules and Genesis craft previews.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping feature IDs to related files, components, tests, and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for various frontend source files used for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app defining views, project types, settings, state handling, and lazy‑loaded pages.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Alert dialog component wired to confirm destructive actions using global confirm store.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project with inputs for name, symbol, size, and pixel‑art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile that starts the flow for creating a new project.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing an existing project’s name, symbol, size, and pixel‑art mode.
Visual tile showing project details with options to open, configure, or delete the project.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing attribution with a heart icon and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with navigation, project info, mobile menu, and save‑status indicator.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Hover/focus tooltip wrapper rendering a popover-style tooltip on interaction.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports a set of lightweight inline SVG React icon components as replacements for lucide-react icons.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Reusable animated icon button with scale/transition effects and focus styling.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Provides a dialog explaining how to obtain the Pinata JWT token with step‑by‑step instructions and warnings.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a small, fixed‑width text indicator showing save status states like saving or saved.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Manages locking, unlocking, and uploading a generated NFT collection to IPFS with progress handling and error states.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle buttons to switch between compact and grid NFT vault views.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor using react-query, refreshing it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Zustand store and hook providing a promise-based destructive action confirmation modal.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling identity loading, login, logout, and auth-client configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Validates a Pinata JWT with debouncing and returns status and messages based on validation results.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base, theme variables, motion settings, and custom utility classes for UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: NFT builder page handling trait selection, preview rendering, file uploads, and token management.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main project dashboard with project creation, opening, editing, and deletion workflows. Manages dialogs for creating and editing project settings.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Generates live NFT previews by merging selected traits on a canvas and supports shuffling valid trait combinations. Handles pixel mode rendering and rule validation.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Provides UI for adjusting and normalizing trait rarity weights per layer. Initializes missing weights and updates project state with proportional recalculations.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of compatibility rules between traits. Validates rule input and updates project rule definitions.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Handles project-level settings including metadata format, blockchain sync, and Solana creator configuration. Updates local and persisted settings with validation.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: React page managing NFT generation via a web worker, handling progress, batching, and vault display controls.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: UI for managing layers and traits in a project, supporting creation, editing, deletion, and rule cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata with progress tracking and metadata construction.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds ERC-721 or Solana metadata structures and image URIs for NFTs based on project settings.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides localStorage persistence with last-write-wins saving, legacy cleanup, and storage size utilities.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Pinata API helpers for validating JWTs and uploading single files, JSON, or directories to IPFS.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines TypeScript interfaces and type guards for all messages exchanged between the Vault UI and the NFT generator worker.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Provides an async helper that yields to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during heavy tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Implements the NFT generation worker handling trait selection, rule checks, DNA creation, optional image compositing, and metadata assembly.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions including colors, spacing, fonts, and animations for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current IPFS/Pinata upload workflow requirements, known issues, and feature specifications for directory-based image and metadata uploads.
